create_empty_mfg_state: create an empty mean field game state from an N player dynamic routing game
build_derived_nplayer_policy: build a DerivedNPlayerPolicyFromMeanFieldPolicy that applies a mean field policy to an N player dynamic routing game
convert_state_to_mean_field_state: convert an N player dynamic routing game state to a mean field routing game state for a given player
get_action_probabilities: get action probabilities for a specified player in an N player dynamic routing game using the mean field policy
memoize_state_conversion: memoize conversions of N player game state string representations to corresponding mean field states
